phase_title: Chrome Refinement — Topbar Island + Search→cmdk + Nav Pill + Tooltips + Drawer Scrim

operations.REPLACE_topbar_search: replaced .topbar-search div+input with .topbar-search-btn (data-action=open-cmdk + svg + label + ⌘K kbd)
operations.ADD_css_atelier_p4_block: ~200 lines (topbar island compaction, search button, pill indicator with spring transform, tooltip system, drawer scrim)
operations.ADD_iife_upg_chrome: ~120 lines (search→cmdk delegation, MutationObserver pill follower, swipe-to-close drawer, resize/theme/collapse re-position hooks)

behaviors_added: Topbar shrinks visually (label + kbd hide, breadcrumb fades, page-icon scales 88%) when document scrolls past 4px (uses existing data-scrolled hook)
Click anywhere on topbar search button (or focus + Enter) opens command palette
Active nav-item has a 3px spring-slide pill indicator on the inline-end edge (hidden in collapsed mode)
When sidebar is collapsed (Cmd+\), each nav-item shows a tooltip on hover with the original label
Mobile drawer (≤980px) shows scrim overlay; clicking scrim closes drawer (via existing data-action='close-drawer' delegation in Upg.nav)
Touch swipe of >60px horizontal on mobile drawer closes it (independent of scrim click)
next_action: Continue Worker 14 Phase 5 — Motion Choreography (read prompts/14_PHASE_5_MOTION_CHOREOGRAPHY.md first). Same branch worker-14-atelier-p2-p6.
